subject.title: Rancho Santa Margarita City Council, District 1

text: Planning Commissioner, City of Rancho Santa Margarita
We need dedicated, experienced, proven leaders on our City Council, especially when our city and residents face significant economic and social challenges.
Today, Rancho Santa Margarita is thriving.
RSM is safe: Ranked by the FBI as #1 safest city in Orange County!
RSM is financially strong: Our city maintains a balanced budget, finished last year with a surplus, and has saved over $30 Million in reserves.
RSM protects taxpayers: Our city earned the prestigious Government Finance Officers Association Certificate of Achievement for Excellence in Financial Reporting.

RSM is beautiful: Our City constructed the beautiful RSM monument sign at the Alicia gateway into Rancho – and this year, the gorgeous RSM monument sign, decorative fencing/median improvements along the Antonio gateway into Rancho. Enhanced street lighting/median improvements have been installed all across our City.

RSM provides a special quality of life: Our city opened the children’s Splash Pad in Central Park, synchronized traffic signals to reduce congestion, upgraded animal services to join a local no kill shelter, sponsored free summer concerts and the annual Rancho Family Fest community celebration.
I’m proud to serve as your Planning Commissioner -- and of everything our city has accomplished.
Thanks to years of hard work and responsible leadership, Rancho Santa Margarita is strong and its future bright.
Upon my election, my primary goals are to maintain our city’s financial security and protect its award-winning master plan.
I will ensure residents continue to be protected by the finest fully funded police and firefighting services.
I will support policies promoting lower taxes, conservative fiscal policies, strong families, vibrant local businesses, reduced traffic, wildfire preparedness, and safe neighborhoods and parks.
I’m well qualified to serve.

I’m a Regional Vice President in the emergency recovery and restoration industry, overseeing operations, budgets, personnel development, and multimillion dollar performance goals across multiple states.

For years I served as President of the Rancho Santa Margarita Chamber of Commerce and as Chairman of Rancho Family Fest. I’m also involved with our local church, schools and youth activities, RSM Cares and other community organizations.

My wife, Amanda, and I have lived in Rancho Santa Margarita for more than twenty years. Our son serves our country in the United States Coast Guard, and we are raising our two younger daughters in this community we proudly call home.
I’m a dedicated, experienced, proven leader -- and proud to be endorsed by Mayor Tony Beall.
I respectfully ask for your vote.
www.Josh4RSM.com

text: Financial Operations Manager

Since 1996, my family has called Rancho Santa Margarita home. Then, the Santa Margarita Marketplace was still the site of the rodeo, and a neighborhood cow greeted our residents in the mornings. Yet, while the landscape has changed, the values of our community certainly have not. These are the values I was raised on: hard work, personal responsibility, and accountability. From Robinson Elementary and Rancho Santa Margarita Intermediate to Saddleback College and UCLA - and from serving lemonade off Plano Trabuco to serving as a Financial Operations Manager, this community has shaped who I am today.

At UCLA, I studied economics and public policy, and majored in political science. While attending, I led an investigation into our campus that brought billions of dollars in losses and the systemic failures behind them to public attention. I also served as Chairman of the Oversight Committee, responsible for helping ensure the student government's multi-million-dollar budget was managed effectively and transparently. These experiences reinforced the values and skills that I will bring to our city: fiscal responsibility, accountability, transparency, and a commitment to protect our tax dollars.

Currently, I work as a Financial Operations Manager, where I oversee and optimize my company's budget and operations. Every day, I am entrusted with making responsible financial decisions, controlling costs, and ensuring resources are utilized optimally - all experiences that I will bring to City Hall.

I remained home as the Airport Fire ravaged the hills above, witnessing firsthand the cost and risks we continue to face. Since then, I have been determined to help keep our homes insurable, our rates lowered, and our families, not our properties, as our only concern during an emergency. Through my planned home-hardening initiative, our city can pursue this by reducing property risk, leveraging state resources, and working directly with insurers
all without the need of our city’s finances.

As your councilmember, I will fight to preserve and build upon the achievements and values of our community. This means ensuring our budget stays balanced, maintaining our nationally recognized public safety, and keeping our taxes and costs as low as possible. At the same time, I will lead our city towards supporting our families and properties in new and meaningful ways, working to ensure our homes are insured, and our neighborhoods are best prepared for any emergencies.
I respectfully ask for your vote so I may serve our community with the responsibility, dedication, and transparency necessary to preserve our remarkable city. reese4council.com
